question: What is the meaning of life cycle assessment (lca) in relation to sustainability?
description: Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) is a methodology used to analyze and quantify the environmental aspects and impacts of product systems over their entire life cycle. It helps in assessing the environmental performance of products, processes, or buildings from the extraction of raw materials to their disposal. By considering all stages of a product's life cycle, LCA aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of the environmental implications and sustainability aspects associated with a particular product or process.
